facts.fact: The record on Maroc Telecom's 9,414 km West Africa submarine cable states it has a landing point at Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, and that the south segment (Casablanca to CIV, Togo, Benin, Gabon, Mauritania; 20 Tbps) became operational in July 2021.
